items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had Pee Wee---not Pee Wee Russell. No, we actually had him... But it was Pee Wee Russell and some of the Dixieland players. Some of the guys were on staff, but they brought some guys into play that show.

ctx.x: We had Pee Wee---not Pee Wee Russell. No, we actually had him. Sonny Ago, was the drummer. He wasn’t a Dixieland drummer per se but he was versatile enough to be a little play that style. We had test – what was that guy’s name?
